Pulling all the meat from the shell in one go fills you with a sense of accomplishment.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Sneaky River Escargots are a type of [[Roasted Food]], and they can be made by burning a [[Sneaky River Snail]] near [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} They can found as a drop after defeating a [[Blue Hinox]]. Their meat is supposed to be soft and chewy, and pulling it out of the shell whole provides one with a sense of accomplishment. Eating one restores one and a half [[Heart]]s to [[Link]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Sneaky River Escargots reappear in {{TotK}} and are again a variety of [[Roasted Food]]. They can be made by exposing [[Sneaky River Snail]]s to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. Their meat is supposed to be soft and chewy, and pulling it out of the shell whole provides one with a sense of accomplishment. Eating one restores one and a half [[Heart]]s to [[Link]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Blueshell Escargot * Food * Frozen River Snail * Roasted Food * Sneaky River Snail }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Roasted Food, Seafood |items= BotW, TotK }}
